description:
The generic tool audit stays inside its card on a 360px-wide phone. The page defines window.__auditHTML, the markup of a generic tool card. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /new and wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s).
2. Replace the page with the card: in an eval, set document.body.innerHTML = window.__auditHTML.
3. The card (".tool-result-details") and the warning (".generic-tool-warning") are visible.
4. The summary (".tool-result-summary") does not overflow: its scrollWidth <= clientWidth (an eval with expect "true").
5. Neither the status (".tool-result-status") nor the warning sticks out of the summary: each one's getBoundingClientRect().right <= the summary's getBoundingClientRect().right (one eval with expect "true").

steps.expression: (function() { var summary = document.querySelector('.tool-result-summary').getBoundingClientRect(); var status = document.querySelector('.tool-result-status').getBoundingClientRect(); var warning = document.querySelector('.generic-tool-warning').getBoundingClientRect(); return String(status.right <= summary.right && warning.right <= summary.right); })()
